description: Finds ceramic raw materials (feldspars, clays, frits, fluxes) and, if asked, colorants in Glazecalc's library by name, alias or maker. Use it to find the exact name the other tools take.

category.description: Only this category: feldspar, clay, frit, flux, silica...

query.description: Words in the name, such as "custer", "ferro 3134" or "kaolin".

region.description: Where the potter buys materials, so suggestions are ones sold there: US, UK, EU or AU. Leave it out for any.

name: search_materials
title: Search the material library
